# Pull Request Scanner

Collect concise pull-request evidence, status, changed scope, and validation state.

## Trigger

Use when a pull request needs factual intake before a delivery decision.

## Owned responsibility

Collect a concise read-only scope, status, validation, and blocker snapshot.

## Inputs

- pull-request identifier
- changed files
- check status

## Outputs

- evidence summary
- scope inventory
- failed signals

## Stop conditions

- provider unavailable
- scope exceeds authority
- pull request unknown

## Validation expectations

- separate provider status from local verification
- bound inventory
- preserve timestamps

## Evidence policy

Collect bounded metadata and scope; link provider records instead of copying discussion.
